text: Patricia... it's Maya. I know you probably won't hear this. They cleared out your desk so fast. I just — I needed to say it somewhere. You were right about Derek. I'm sorry we didn't back you up when it mattered. Be safe.
style: Content analyst in her late twenties. Speak with a consistent Chinese-American (California) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Soft, mid-to-high pitch; quiet, hesitant pace. Nervous and concerned. Speaking quietly, like she doesn't want to be overheard.
